files.content: 4 tests (1 host + 3 GPU #[ignore]): shadow-on criteria, shadow-off bitwise pre-unlock regression, visibility control, reference parsing
minimal read-only npz reader (ZIP_STORED + npy v1.0, no npz dependency) for S3a capture references + frozen sha256 assertions + reference-level difference counters
scene-shadow product scene assembly (fields_from_model + light_castshadow=[1,1,1]) + comparison/assertion/run hash helpers

criteria.shadow_on: product nworld=1 + scene-shadow + use_shadows=true vs capture/shadow-on: RGB per-channel <= 1 LSB, depth <= 4 ULP (bit-exact mismatched==0 preferred), seg exact; two runs sha256 identical
criteria.shadow_off_1: vs capture/shadow-off: same criteria as shadow-on
criteria.shadow_off_2: bitwise regression to pre-unlock same-recipe product reference: depth/seg vs s7b1::RECIPE_REFERENCE mismatched==0; RGB vs s7b2::parse_rgb_fast_math_false_reference() max_byte_diff==0 (S8 pre-unlock measured 0)
criteria.visibility_control: semantic cross-check only: product shadow-on vs shadow-off difference pixel counts alongside reference-level counts; asserts product depth/seg do not change with use_shadows and RGB must change; no equivalence/precision conclusion

reference_recipe_note.product_recipe: exact f32 kernel; 'same recipe' in existing S7b/S8 criteria means use_fast_math=false capture
reference_recipe_note.consequence: capture/ reference comparisons are executed with the <=1 LSB / <=4 ULP criteria and their cross-recipe nature is recorded in window results; the same-recipe hard criterion is carried by shadow-off (2) against the existing fast_math_false references
reference_recipe_note.shadow_off_equals_s0b_reference: capture/shadow-off/ depth+seg sha equal scene-a/reference/ depth+seg; rgb sha 9379f5d3... equals scene-a/reference/rgb.npz

authoring_validation.host_test: cargo test --locked --features cuda-probe --test render_shadow_reference -> 1 passed; 0 failed; 3 ignored (logs/host-test.log)
authoring_validation.gates: normify gate 2026-10-28-render-bvh-r09-s3b-shadow-validation executed on the in_progress commit tree; results in .normify/runs/2026-10-28-render-bvh-r09-s3b-shadow-validation/ (fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit all passed); re-runs required on the final tree at closure

frozen_target_candidate.note: authoring-stage build artifact; the window freeze must rebuild from the committed tree and re-verify sha/bytes before opening

commands: each of the 8 regression entities with -- --ignored --test-threads=1
window_plan.preconditions: signed runner + precheck (util<40 x3, free>=10240, compute-apps filtered 0, no build processes); floor = min(10240, baseline_free - 3072); 0.25 s sampler for device-verification windows
window_plan.pending: Arch reports window material to Chief; window not opened in this stage

limitations: authoring stage only: no GPU test was executed and no window verdict is made
no rendering numeric conclusion; cross-recipe nature of the capture reference is recorded honestly and not presented as an equivalence or precision claim
if shadow-off bitwise regression fails inside the window (depth/seg mismatched!=0 or RGB max_byte_diff!=0) the work stops and reports to Arch; criteria are not relaxed

if shadow-on versus the fast-math capture reference exceeds criteria inside the window, results are recorded as-is and handled by Arch/Chief decision (possible same-recipe supplement capture); criteria are not relaxed
references and fixtures remain read-only; no .gitattributes change
